prompt:
图片1 is the exact approved paper-and-bamboo theatre snake, used ONLY to establish the jaw construction, inside width, proportions and quiet flat-colour style. Make an independent PROP SHEET of its lightweight PAPER MOON DISK AND SINGLE PULLING STRING. This is a flat round rice-white paper sheet stretched on a thin bamboo hoop, not a ball or an astronomical moon. Disk diameter is about TWO THIRDS of the snake jaw's usable LEFT-TO-RIGHT inner width. The back has two fine crossing bamboo braces. A small plain fabric eyelet at the TOP of the hoop anchors ONE thin light-grey string; the string continues to a simple loose end long enough to grip, no reel or extra machinery.
Layout, all complete within the16:9 canvas: upper-left, front view of the flat circular moon with the whole attached string curving gently into the empty upper margin and its loose end visible. Upper-right, back view of the SAME disk, same size, same top eyelet, same brace arrangement, same single string and complete free end. Do not crop the string beyond the canvas. The back is lightly translucent only enough to distinguish the bamboo, never a solid wooden shield.
Bottom centre, ONE compact assembly-clearance illustration using the SAME snake head as图片1 in its same three-quarter view. Keep the jaw/lower-lip construction and colour recognisable. Show the moon held just OUTSIDE the open lips, aligned ready to enter, with a small visible gap between disk and lips; do not show a swallowed or clamped moon. Here the FLAT disk is tilted approximately parallel to the lower-jaw plane, so perspective makes the circle appear elliptical. Its lateral diameter is two thirds of the available inner jaw width, with clear space on both sides, and its tilted thin plane fits between the upper and lower jaw. The complete upper lip, lower lip and both side edges must remain visible, not hidden by an oversized vertical moon. Do not enlarge the moon compared to the reference jaw; do not draw a tiny unrelated snake. No additional disk scattered nearby. The single control string remains connected to the same top edge of the disk.
Clean muted grey-green snake, warm off-white paper, restrained tan bamboo, fine outlines, broad flat colour and only two shadow levels; a plain warm-grey background. No people, sky, stars, real snake anatomy, fangs, texture, grain, text, numbers, measurement arrows or caption. Native4K16:9, preserve original encoding.
